key_insight: Under conventional training, capsule networks were more robust to adversarial perturbations than the tested CNNs and vision transformer across all five datasets.
clinical_relevance: Capsule networks may improve the reliability of medical image classifiers under adversarial perturbations, but clinical safety and effectiveness remain unproven.
method: Compared two capsule networks, ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and MedViT.
Evaluated five adversarial attack approaches and performed PGD adversarial fine-tuning.
Analyzed feature stability using latent-space visualizations and Grad-CAM.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered four medical imaging datasets and MNIST; the abstract reports greater capsule-network robustness and more consistent feature representations under conventional training.
watch_item: The supplied abstract is incomplete and provides neither numerical effect sizes nor results after adversarial fine-tuning, limiting assessment of the advantage.
paper_title: Adversarial Robustness of Capsule Networks for Medical Image Classification
